name: 语音节奏分析
description: 分析语音节奏、速度和韵律模式，以检测视频中的AI生成语音。
useCase: Detecting synthetic speech in 深度伪造视频 through temporal speech 模式 分析
mechanism: 提取 speech rate, pause duration, pitch contour, and emphasis 模式 from audio tracks. Natural speech has characteristic variability in cadence, while AI生成的 speech often shows unnatural uniformity or periodic 模式 in rhythm and intonation.
accuracy: 高 - 80-90% on synthetic speech 检测
source: MÃ¼ller et al. (2022) - Does Audio Deepfake Detection Generalize?, Interspeech
algorithm: Prosody Feature Extraction + Temporal Pattern Analysis + Statistical Deviation Scoring
parameters: Window: 500ms, Features: F0 contour, speech rate, pause ratio, jitter, shimmer
